title: Mitosis architecture audit and rebuild exploration

completion_criteria.text: Foundational audit of the current engine complete across all four domains: two-layer fan-out, durability/resume, cost/latency, pipeline rigidity + fragility
External research verdict delivered on whether the architecture is correct, with disconfirming pass and cited prior art
The child_process runtime-capability question settled empirically (does dynamic import of node:child_process EXECUTE inside a Workflow script, not merely resolve)

Three open architecture decisions resolved by the user: adopt an off-the-shelf durable-execution runtime vs only its state model; default speculation depth given that rework costs tokens not machine time; which work-type pipelines to define first
An approved architecture spec for the rebuild exists, superseding or explicitly scoping the six paused repair-oriented mitosis threads

spine.active_goal: The recorded explanation task is DELIVERED and the thread has pivoted. 0219 refuted the preflight's premise (mitosis.js carries zero merge invocations; three deny layers already hold) and 0220 ruled DELETE-not-neuter, re-homing the real boundary as a ~15-line test. The thread's next output is IMPLEMENTATION - the first repo write this thread makes - executed as one MSP with plan, implement and review, per the user's explicit go.
spine.next_step: START HERE IN A FRESH SESSION. Plan, implement and review the preflight deletion per 0219/0220 as ONE MSP on a fresh branch off origin/main. Put asks (a) and (b) to the user FIRST.
open_risks: TWO OPEN ASKS, put first: (a) fold the ~15-line replacement test into the deletion or ship it separately; (b) supersede 0218 in the same PR or its own record. 0219 already supersedes 0218 in the ledger.

SELF-APPROVAL UNVERIFIED: that GitHub forbids a PR author approving their own PR was NOT checked against GitHub docs. Load-bearing for 0219's invariant-3 deadlock claim. Verify before citing it in a PR body, spec or commit.

PR BODIES FREEZE AT CREATION (0142): gh pr edit, api PATCH, GraphQL and the MCP update tool are gate-denied. Later facts go in a COMMENT. pr-create rejects angle brackets in --what and caps free text at 200 chars.
MERGE IS NOT GATED here: gh api returns 404 'Branch not protected' on main and there are no required status checks, so a red CI does not block the merge button. A red must be surfaced in words.
STALE LEDGER COPIES (0209): decisions/ dirs under .claude/plugins/data/ are stale and once produced a false BLOCKING finding. Only the _ledger git ref is authoritative.
STANDING: plan fix rounds against INVARIANTS, never a finding list. Fence reviewers with 'cite the supplied receipts, re-run nothing' and leave exactly ONE agent permitted to execute checks.
